changes.title: Boar horns
items: The legendary boar charges head down with enormous twisting horns sweeping back over its hump, fire at their tips, its eyes glinting below; the adult shows their first nubs

changes.title: Prop generator
items: Try ?props=gen: the moor's standing stones are grey slabs, its cairns low heaps, its pools all different shapes, and the muddy forest's broken trunks keep their branches attached

changes.title: Creator bedroom
items: The character creator is now her messy treehouse bedroom, seen from above: the bed with her laptop glowing on it, clothes and hats everywhere, open books with glowing runes, DJ decks, a guitar, a synth and a drum, potions and crystals, candles, the PARTY TONIGHT banner, and a round window on the night
Click her to switch between standing and hovering on her broom
